headings: Our primary goal is to deliver attractive total returns to our shareholders. This section sets forth key components of our business and growth strategies that we have in place to support this goal.
paragraphs: COPT Defense Properties ("COPT Defense") and subsidiaries (collectively, the "Company", "we" or "us") is a fully-integrated and self-managed real estate investment trust ("REIT") focused on owning, operating and developing properties in locations proximate to, or sometimes containing, key U.S. Government ("USG") defense installations and missions (which we refer to herein as our Defense/IT Portfolio). Our tenants include the USG and its defense contractors, who are primarily engaged in priority national security activities, and who generally require mission-critical and high security property enhancements. Our property portfolio is predominantly comprised of office properties and single-tenant data center shells. As of December 31, 2025, our Defense/IT Portfolio included:
•201 operating properties totaling 23.2 million square feet. We owned 24 of these properties totaling 4.3 million square feet through unconsolidated real estate joint ventures;
•fiveproperties under development that will total approximately 646,000 square feet upon completion; and
•approximately 1,000 acres of land controlled that we believe could be developed into approximately 10.6 million square feet.

We also owned sixother operating properties totaling 2.0 million square feet and approximately 50 acres of other developable land in the Greater Washington, DC/Baltimore region as of December 31, 2025.

We conduct almost all of our operations and own almost all of our assets through our operating partnership, COPT Defense Properties, L.P. ("CDPLP") and subsidiaries (collectively, the "Operating Partnership"), of which COPT Defense is the sole general partner. CDPLP owns real estate directly and through subsidiary partnerships and limited liability companies ("LLCs"). In addition to owning real estate, CDPLP also owns subsidiaries that provide real estate services such as property management, development and construction services primarily for our properties but also for third parties, most of which are tenants. Some of these services are performed by a taxable REIT subsidiary ("TRS").

Equity interests in CDPLP are in the form of common and preferred units. As of December 31, 2025, COPT Defense owned 97.5% of the outstanding CDPLP common units ("common units") and there were no preferred units outstanding. Common units not owned by COPT Defense carry certain redemption rights. The number of common units owned by COPT Defense is equivalent to the number of outstanding common shares of beneficial interest ("common shares") of COPT Defense, and the entitlement of common units to quarterly distributions and payments in liquidation is substantially the same as that of COPT Defense common shareholders.
COPT Defense's common shares are publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") under the ticker symbol "CDP".

We believe that COPT Defense is organized and has operated in a manner that satisfies the requirements for taxation as a REIT under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, and we intend to continue to operate COPT Defense in such a manner. If COPT Defense continues to qualify for taxation as a REIT, it generally will not be subject to federal income tax on its taxable income (other than that of its TRS entities) that is distributed to its shareholders. A REIT is subject to a number of organizational and operational requirements, including a requirement that it distribute at least 90% of its annual taxable income to its shareholders.
Our executive offices are located at 6711 Columbia Gateway Drive, Suite 300, Columbia, Maryland 21046 and our telephone number is (443) 285-5400.

Our internet address is www.copt.com. We make available on our internet website free of charge our annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K and amendments to those reports filed or furnished pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), as soon as reasonably possible after we file such material with the SEC. In addition, we have made available on our internet website under the heading "Investors" and sub-heading "Governance" the charters for our Board of Trustees' Audit, Compensation, Investment and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committees, as well as our Corporate Governance Guidelines, Code of Business Conduct and Ethics and Code of Ethics for Financial Officers. We intend to make available on our website any future amendments or waivers to our Code of Business Conduct and Ethics and Code of Ethics for Financial Officers within four business days after any such amendments or waivers. The information on our internet site is not part of this report.

The SEC maintains an internet website that contains reports, proxy and information statements and other information regarding issuers that file electronically with the SEC. This internet website can be accessed at www.sec.gov.

Defense/IT Strategy: We focus on owning, operating and developing Defense/IT Portfolio properties, which as of December 31, 2025 accounted for 201 of our 207 properties, representing 90.3% of our annualized rental revenue ("ARR"), and we control developable land to accommodate future growth in this portfolio. The properties in this portfolio are adjacent to, or contain, their demand drivers, whose activities pertain more to knowledge and technology missions of the USG (i.e., research and development and other highly-technical defense and security areas) rather than to force structure (i.e., troops) and weapon system mass production. These risks and uncertainties may lead to outcomes that could adversely affect our financial position, results of operations, cash flows or ability to make expected distributions to our shareholders. You should carefully consider each of these risks and uncertainties, along with all of the information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and its Exhibits, including our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto for the year ended December 31, 2025 included in a separate section at the end of this report beginning on page F-1.

Our performance and asset value are subject to risks associated with our properties and with the real estate industry. Real estate investments are subject to various risks and fluctuations in value and demand, many of which are beyond our control. Our performance and the value of our real estate assets may decline due to conditions in the general economy and the real estate industry, which could adversely affect our financial position, results of operations, cash flows or ability to make expected distributions to our shareholders. Future events and actual results may differ materially from those discussed in the forward-looking statements. Important factors that may affect these expectations, estimates and projections include, but are not limited to:

•general economic and business conditions, which will, among other things, affect office property and data center demand and rents, tenant creditworthiness, interest rates, financing availability, property operating and construction costs, and property values;
•adverse changes in the real estate markets, including, among other things, increased competition with other companies;
•our ability to borrow on favorable terms or at all;

•risks of property acquisition and development activities, including, among other things, risks that development projects may not be completed on schedule, that tenants may not take occupancy or pay rent or that development or operating costs may be greater than anticipated;

•risks of investing through joint venture structures, including risks that our joint venture partners may not fulfill their financial obligations as investors or may take actions that are inconsistent with our objectives;
•changes in our plans for properties or views of market economic conditions or failure to obtain development rights, either of which could result in recognition of significant impairment losses;

•potential impact of prolonged government shutdowns or budgetary reductions or impasses, such as a reduction of rental revenues, non-renewal of leases and/or reduced or delayed demand for additional space by existing or new tenants;
•potential additional costs, such as capital improvements, fees and penalties, associated with environmental laws or regulations;
•adverse changes resulting from other government actions and initiatives, such as changes in taxation, zoning laws or other regulations;
•our ability to satisfy and operate effectively under federal income tax rules relating to real estate investment trusts and partnerships;
•the dilutive effects of issuing additional common shares; and
•security breaches relating to cyber attacks, cyber intrusions or other factors, and other significant disruptions of our information technology networks and related systems.

headings: 本公司主要目標為為股東提供具吸引力的總回報。本節說明我們為達成此目標所實施的業務與成長策略之關鍵零組件。
paragraphs: COPT Defense Properties ("COPT Defense") 以及其子公司（合稱為 "本公司"、"我們" 或 "我們"）為一間完全整合且自營的不動產投資信託（"REIT"），專注於擁有、營運及開發位於美國政府（"USG"）防衛設施及任務附近或包含這些設施的不動產（我們在此稱為 Defence/IT 範疇）。我們的租戶包括 USG 及其防衛承包商，這些承包商主要從事國家安全優先活動，通常需要任務關鍵且高安全性的不動產改善。我們的不動產組合主要由辦公室不動產及單租戶資料中心殼體組成。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的 Defence/IT 範疇包含：
•201 運作中不動產，總計 23.2 百萬平方英呎。我們透過未合併的不動產合資企業，擁有其中 24 項不動產，總計 4.3 百萬平方英呎；
•五項正在開發中的不動產，預計完工後總計約 646,000 平方英呎；以及
•約 1,000 英畝的土地，我們認為可開發成約 10.6 百萬平方英呎；
我們在 2025 年 12 月 31 日也擁有六項其他運作中不動產，總計 2.0 百萬平方英呎，以及約 50 英畝的其他可開發土地，位於華盛頓特區/巴爾的摩地區；

我們幾乎所有的運作均透過我們的營運合夥企業 COPT Defense Properties, L.P.（"CDPLP"）及其子公司（合稱為 "營運合夥企業"）進行，COPT Defense 為營運合夥企業的唯一普通合夥人。CDPLP 直接擁有不動產，並透過子公司合夥企業及有限責任公司（"LLCs"）擁有不動產。除了擁有不動產，CDPLP 還擁有提供不動產服務的子公司，例如物業管理、開發及建設服務，主要為我們的不動產提供，但也為第三方提供，大多數為租戶。其中一些服務由可課稅 REIT 子公司（"TRS"）執行。

CDPLP 的權益形式為普通及優先單位。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，COPT Defense 擁有 CDPLP 普通單位（"普通單位"）97.5% 的發行在外數量，且無優先單位發行在外。未由 COPT Defense 擁有的普通單位具有某些贖回權利。COPT Defense 擁有的普通單位數量等同於 COPT Defense 普通股份（"普通股份"）的發行在外數量，普通單位在季度分紅及清算付款方面的權利與 COPT Defense 普通股股東幾乎相同。
COPT Defense 的普通股份在紐約證券交易所（"NYSE"）公開交易，股票代碼為 "CDP"。

我們認為 COPT Defense 係以符合 1986 年內政部稅收法（Internal Revenue Code）修正後之規定，作為 REIT（Real Estate Investment Trust）進行組織與運作，我們意圖持續以該方式運作 COPT Defense。若 COPT Defense 繼續符合作為 REIT 的稅收條件，則其對股東分派之可課稅所得（不包括其 TRS 企業之所得）一般不會課徵聯邦所得稅。REIT 會受到若干組織與運作要求的限制，包括其必須將至少 90% 的年度可課稅所得分派給股東。
本公司高層辦公室位於馬裏蘭州 Columbia 的 6711 Columbia Gateway Drive, Suite 300，郵遞區號 21046，電話號碼為 (443) 285-5400。

防禦/資訊科技策略：我們專注於擁有、營運及發展防禦/資訊科技組合資產，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，該組合資產佔本公司 207 處資產中的 201 處，佔本公司年度化租金收入（"ARR"）的 90.3%，且我們掌控可開發土地以配合此組合資產未來的成長。該組合資產中的資產與其需求驅動因素為鄰近或包含於內，這些需求驅動因素之活動更偏向於美國政府（USG）之知識與科技任務（即研究與發展及其他高技術防禦與安全領域），而非於軍事結構（即部隊）與武器系統大規模生產。我們防禦/資訊科技組合資產之需求驅動因素包括：
•美國政府機構及機關之高優先級設施與任務，支持防禦與國家安全活動，例如情報、監視、偵察、飛彈防禦與太空活動、網路安全與網路活動、研究與發展及先進武器系統測試與工程，位於馬裏蘭州、亞拉巴馬州亨茨維爾、維吉尼亞州北部、華盛頓特區及德克薩斯州聖安東尼奧。

本節包含所謂的「預測性」陳述，如1995年私人證券訴訟改革法案所定義，這些陳述是根據我們目前對未來事件及影響本公司業務財務狀況與營運的財務趨勢的預期、估計與預測所作出。預測性陳述可透過使用如「可能」、「將」、「應」、「可能」、「相信」、「預期」、「估計」、「計畫」或其他類似用語來辨識。預測性陳述本質上會受到風險與不確定性的影響，許多風險我們無法準確預測，有些我們甚至可能未預期。雖然我們相信這些預測性陳述所反映的預期、估計與預測是基於當時合理的假設所作出，但我們無法保證這些預期、估計與預測會實現。未來事件與實際結果可能與預測性陳述中所討論的有重大差異。影響這些預期、估計與預測的重要因素包括，但不僅限於：
•總體經濟與商業條件，這將影響辦公室用不動產與資料中心的需求與租金、租戶信用狀況、利率、融資可得性、不動產營運與建設成本以及不動產價值；
•不動產市場的不利變動，包括增加與其他公司的競爭；
•我們能否以有利條件或任何條件取得貸款；
•不動產取得與開發活動的風險，包括開發專案可能無法按時完成、租戶可能無法進駐或支付租金，或開發或營運成本可能高於預期；
•透過合資結構進行投資的風險，包括合資夥伴可能無法履行投資者的財務義務，或採取與我們目標不一致的行動；
•我們對不動產的計畫或對市場總體經濟條件的看法變更，或無法取得開發權，這兩種情況都可能導致認列重大減損損失；
•長時間政府停擺或預算減少或僵局所可能造成的影響，例如租金收入減少、租約不續約及/或現有或新租戶對額外空間需求減少或延遲；
•因應環境法規或法規而可能產生的額外成本，例如資本改善、費用及處罰；
•其他政府行動及政策所導致的不利變動，例如稅收變更、 zoning 法規或其他法規變動；
•本公司能否符合並有效運作於有關不動產投資信託及合夥企業的聯邦所得稅規則；
•發行額外普通股可能產生的稀釋效果；以及
•與網路攻擊、網路入侵或其他因素相關的安全漏洞，以及資訊科技網路及相關系統的重大中斷

paragraphs: 下列為與本公司業務及證券持有相關之風險與不確定性。這些風險與不確定性可能導致不利於本公司財務狀況、營運成果、現金流量或無法實現對股東預期分紅之結果。請您謹慎考量這些風險與不確定性，並配合本年度10-K表格年報及其附屬文件中所有資訊，包括本公司合併財務報表及其附註，內容為2025年12月31日財務年度之資料，詳見本報告末尾開始於F-1頁之獨立節錄。
本公司之營運表現與資產價值受本公司不動產與不動產產業之風險影響。不動產投資會面臨各種風險與價值及需求之波動，許多因素為本公司所無法控制。本公司之營運表現與不動產資產價值可能因總體經濟與不動產產業之條件而下降，此可能對本公司財務狀況、營運成果、現金流量或無法實現對股東預期分紅造成不利影響。這些條件包括但不限於：
•國家、區域及地方經濟環境之衰退，包括失業率上升與通貨膨脹或通貨緊縮；
•地方不動產市場條件惡化，例如供給過度、需求減少與租金率下降；
•與租戶相關之不利發展，可能影響本公司收取租金與執行租約續約之能力；
•營運成本增加，包括不動產稅、公共設施費用、保險及其他費用，部分費用本公司可能無法自租戶收回；
